items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I took a liking to this George Mitchell... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he was a nice trumpet man.

ctx.x: Well I can say that such fellow Johnny Dunn played a nice horn but he wasn't a swing man. But you know, I mean he just played a lot of stuff. But he wasn't a swing man. He'd come here with Mamie Smith and these boys got playing around here and he said he had to go back and run over again. Because he didn't do nothing but play behind singers, see? Like I was showing you, she'd sing and he'd hit a few notes behind her and stop and she'd sing something and he'd hit a few notes. And he'd hit a clean swing out like…
I took a liking to this George Mitchell. He used to play with the Red Hot Peppers. Yeah. And I wish I could imitate his sound.
Yeah, he was a nice trumpet man.
